candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes hepatosplenomegaly and dilated portal and splenic veins, which are components of the candidate. These findings are also known manifestations of Niemann-Pick disease type B, the reference diagnosis. However, the candidate does not encompass the full scope of Niemann-Pick disease type B, which is a systemic lysosomal storage disorder.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Portal hypertension with hepatosplenomegaly and dilated portal and splenic veins is a manifestation of Niemann-Pick disease type B.
